jacar-c01004832600.summary: Two Soviet synoptic weather observations (stations 841 and 933), deciphered with key 22244 and table 3 of the reconstructed Moscow tables; identical to the Japanese decipherment printed in the report.

jacar-c01004816500.summary: One Soviet synoptic observation (station 959), deciphered with the substitution and subtractors of type 17040; identical to the Japanese decipherment.

system: Additive/subtractive superencipherment, figure by figure without carrying, of the international synoptic weather code; four generations 1938-1940: fixed additive with group exchange (1938), per-group additives (1938-39), autokey on a substituted first group…
